title: Log every picture or video that takes over 3 s to load
description: Fabio 2026-10-13: after a ~5 h idle the landing covers, crew mascots and project cards took a long time to appear, then the next project was fine. His HAR (Landing4) was saved after DevTools opened, so it holds only a fast reload. MPI-1120's cache reset was in effect (cache rebuilt 09:44). Add an always-on renderer log: every img/video/audio/css/script load over 3 s goes to app.log with its queue / server-wait / download split, so the next occurrence explains itself with no DevTools open.
